title: Let the CAT out of the bag: Contrastive Attributed explanations for Text
reasoning: The paper uses categories like "atheism", "christian", and "religion" from the 20 Newsgroups dataset as attributes for its text classification models. However, it does not conduct an evaluation or benchmarking focused on faith, ethics, or moral aspects of these categories. The "Limitations" section discusses general ethical concerns (discrimination, developer trustworthiness) but this does not constitute a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, and/or ethics.
